caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a trivet made of what appears to be cast iron, depicted in brown hues with areas of lighter brown highlighting the raised features and shadowing against a light beige background. The trivet is oval-shaped with an ornate, openwork design consisting of a central circular motif surrounded by symmetrical, curved, radial arms, and bordered by a textured, gear-like edge. The handle extends from one side and ends in a clover or trefoil-shaped head, continuing the same brown color as the rest of the object. Three legs support the trivet, visible underneath the main circular plate, casting subtle shadows on the surface below. In the bottom right corner of the image, the name "Leslie J. Macklem Del." and the number "390-1" are written in small, neat letters.
title: Flat Iron Stand
